name: usage-band
description: A band above the prompt with context fill by category and rate-limit windows coloured by pace, a toast when a window turns amber or red or resets, plus session cost, cache hit rate, compactions and effort.

limitsThreshold.title: Hide limits below (%)
limitsThreshold.description: Show a rate-limit window only once it reaches this percentage or its pace turns amber or red. 0 always shows every window.

weeklyThreshold.title: Weekly in the collapsed row at (%)
weeklyThreshold.description: Add the weekly (and spend) window to the one-line band once it reaches this percentage or its pace turns amber or red.

resetStyle.title: Reset time
resetStyle.description: countdown shows the time left (↻1h29m); clock shows when the window resets (↻14:30).

alerts.title: Limit toasts
alerts.description: Toast once when a window first turns amber or red, and when a window that had alerted resets.

sessionStats.title: Session stats
sessionStats.description: Show session cost, the last response's cache hit rate, the compaction count and the effort level.
